f_01KXFKP8QEZ5RMMSQWF428SDHW.subject: job_total_estimate
f_01KXFKP8QEZ5RMMSQWF428SDHW.content: The Simons Addition job carries a grand total estimate of $100,778.92 ($45,167.59 labor, $52,171.33 materials, $3,440.00 equipment).

f_01KXFKP8QE852BTGTD1GCV8WHW.subject: addition_size
f_01KXFKP8QE852BTGTD1GCV8WHW.content: The addition is a 30'×10' two-story structure (300 sqft new footprint) adding basement-level storage and a second-floor primary bedroom, master bathroom, and walk-in closet.

f_01KXFKP8QE9M323JZ45WC19ZZZ.subject: job_scheduled_start_date
f_01KXFKP8QE9M323JZ45WC19ZZZ.content: Job is scheduled to start on-site 2026-10-12.

f_01KXFKP8QEBJBXNE62W3RFXRS2.subject: tdec_septic_required
f_01KXFKP8QEBJBXNE62W3RFXRS2.content: Scope explicitly requires a TDEC septic inspection and feasibility study; all septic and grinder pump costs are excluded from the contract total and will require a change order.

f_01KXFKP8QEYQZZ5BYWY1DZ1065.subject: subpanel_in_scope
f_01KXFKP8QEYQZZ5BYWY1DZ1065.content: A 100A electrical subpanel is included in scope, along with a dedicated 120V/30A circuit for a future elevator.

f_01KXFKP8QEG65RAVRX7CFCQTXH.subject: lvl_beam_in_scope
f_01KXFKP8QEG65RAVRX7CFCQTXH.content: One LVL beam (3-ply 14", spanning ~15'-6") is in scope to open an existing load-bearing wall; temporary shoring is included.

f_01KXFKP8QEYJJJ4S788HGBV5RJ.subject: hvac_type
f_01KXFKP8QEYJJJ4S788HGBV5RJ.content: HVAC for the addition is a mini-split system per the breakdown section title; existing HVAC relocations are also included.

f_01KXFKP8QE0CAMKCYSJRX61009.subject: heat_pump_relocation_in_scope
f_01KXFKP8QE0CAMKCYSJRX61009.content: The existing heat pump and electrical disconnect must be relocated as part of demo/site work before the addition footprint can be cleared.

f_01KXFKP8QE0QWKF0W4WHC3K7RY.subject: roof_pitch_tie_in
f_01KXFKP8QE0QWKF0W4WHC3K7RY.content: The new addition roof is a 3/12 gable pitch tying into the existing 6/12 roof; truss vs. rafter framing is listed as TBD during the design phase.

f_01KXFKP8QE2REYP0KKQPMZ9TCA.subject: water_heater_scope_ambiguity
f_01KXFKP8QE2REYP0KKQPMZ9TCA.content: The breakdown CSV title references 'Incl. Tankless WH Option' in the HVAC section ($5,140 materials), but the scope document only calls for extending the existing gas water heater vent through the new roof — it is unclear whether a tankless WH is contracted or an unconfirmed option.

f_01KXFKP8QEV5PPNYFS2QY2ZQKN.subject: hall_bath_section_negative_material
f_01KXFKP8QEV5PPNYFS2QY2ZQKN.content: The 'Existing Hall Bath Mod, Bedroom Remodel & Closeout' section carries -$4,199 material cost and a -$1,714.20 section total against 72 labor hours; this is likely a credit or scope-reduction offset.

f_01KXFKP8QEMA51V9QB3V1GT8F4.subject: elevator_shaft_framed_only
f_01KXFKP8QEMA51V9QB3V1GT8F4.content: The addition scope includes framing an ~4'×4' elevator shaft; the elevator itself is explicitly excluded from scope.
